name: vertex-log-monitor
description: Surfaces whether Vertex AI request/response (prompt+output) logging or Data Access audit logging is enabled for the Claude Code project. Refreshes a small cache on SessionStart and exposes a status reader for a shell prompt (Starship) or on-demand slash command. Zero-config: derives project, region, and models from the ANTHROPIC_* / CLOUD_ML_REGION env vars Claude Code already sets.
